_comment: Concrete technologies and tools, which SFIA deliberately does not enumerate - SFIA describes professional skills such as 'Programming/software development', not 'React'. Each row names the SFIA skill the technology is most often exercised under as an editorial suggestion; the loader only records that mapping once a real SFIA 9 workbook confirms the code exists. These rows are reference vocabulary for retrieval, not statements about any student and not a ranking of what anyone should learn.
